english.note: Use this before a predicate when stressing that no thing is excluded, especially with 都 or a negative.
Use this when the meaning is anything and everything, without choosing particular items.

examples.english: I don't want to eat anything.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 mat1 je5 dou1 m4 soeng2 sik6

examples.english: They eat everything; they really don't mind.
examples.traditional: 佢乜嘢都食，真係冇所謂。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 mat1 je5 dou1 sik6 zan1 hai6 mou5 so2 wai6
